description: The Bible editions available, with language and licence: osnb (Norwegian Bokmål), osnn (Norwegian Nynorsk), osen (English), oses (Spanish) are open CC BY 4.0 translations made by the free-bible project directly from the Hebrew and Greek; sblgnt (Greek New Testament), tanach (Hebrew Old Testament) are the source texts; kjv (King James Version, English), web (World English Bible), bsb (Berean Standard Bible, English), asv (American Standard Version, English), luther_1912 (Luther 1912, German), segond_1910 (Louis Segond 1910, French), rv_1909 (Reina-Valera 1909, Spanish), akjv (American King James Version, English), albanian (Albanian Bible), bungo (Bungo-yaku, classical Japanese), cadman (Cadman 1926, Vietnamese), chinese_union_simp (Chinese Union Version, simplified), chinese_union_trad (Chinese Union Version, traditional), cpdv (Catholic Public Domain Version, English), dbt (Darby Translation, English), diodati (Diodati, Italian), drb (Douay-Rheims (Challoner), English), elberfelder_1905 (Elberfelder 1905, German), elberfelder_1871 (Elberfelder 1871, German), dnb30 (Bibelselskapet 1930, Norwegian Bokmål), erv (English Revised Version), finn (Finnish 1776), geneva (Geneva Bible, English), hcv (Haitian Creole Bible (1985)), he_modern (Modern Hebrew Bible (Delitzsch NT)), jps (JPS Tanakh 1917, English), kougo (Kougo-yaku 1954/55, Japanese), lv_gluck_8 (Glück Bible, Latvian), martin (Martin 1744, French), opt (Old Persian Version, Persian), rv_1858 (Reina-Valera 1858 New Testament, Spanish), sagradas (Sagradas Escrituras 1569, Spanish), slt (Smith's Literal Translation, English), swahili (Swahili New Testament), synodal (Synodal Translation 1876, Russian), tagab (Ang Biblia 1905, Tagalog), wbt (Webster Bible 1833, English), weymouth (Weymouth New Testament 1903, English), ylt (Young's Literal Translation, English), bn_irv (Indian Revised Version, Bengali), gu_irv (Indian Revised Version, Gujarati), irv (Indian Revised Version, Hindi), ha_con (Open Hausa Contemporary Bible), ha_lit (Litafi Mai-tsarki, Hausa New Testament), kn_irv (Indian Revised Version, Kannada), mr_irv (Indian Revised Version, Marathi), pa_irv (Indian Revised Version, Punjabi), ta_irv (Indian Revised Version, Tamil), te_irv (Indian Revised Version, Telugu), coverdale (Coverdale Bible 1535, English) are open translations, public domain or CC BY-SA — list_editions gives each one's licence and the credit it requires.
